Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of this game! The series is now levelled at 1-1 and the decider will be played on Friday, 21st January 2022. The first ball of this decider will be bowled at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). But as you all know, the buildup will begin well in advance. So please tune in early. Till then, cheers and goodbye!

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe, is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that the ball was coming on the bat nicely. But Jeffrey Vandersay got a lot of purchase off it and clearly, there was more in it for the spinners.  Adds that in the first game they were a few runs short, but today the seamers did an excellent job, they picked up early wickets. Mentions that they are happy with the team combination so far. Concludes by saying that they were under pressure coming into this game, but hats off to the boys for the win today.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, says that when he first went into bat, he did not look at the scoreboard and just went on to score runs. Adds that at first the ball was coming on nicely but later the ball was skidding. On being asked if he felt they played with one less batter, he replies that they were a batsman short. He thinks number 8 is a crucial position and concludes by saying that they did not bowl well and also their top-order did not click, and they will look into both the aspects for the next game.
...The Presentation...

Sri Lanka would be very disappointed with the way they fared with the bat, considering that it was a very good surface to bat on. They lost wickets early on in the innings and were under the pump right from the word go. At one point, Sri Lanka were struggling at 63/4 but then it was their skipper, Dasun Shanaka and Kamindu Mendis who did the repair work. They both batted with caution at first and once they were set, they started playing their shots. The pair of Shanaka and Mendis stitched together a partnership of 118 runs and that ensured that the hosts were still in the contest. Shanaka also brought up his maiden ODI hundred but perished soon after and Sri Lanka were in a spot of bother. Once the hosts lost their skipper, it was always going to be an uphill task for them and Sri Lanka fell short in the end by 22 runs.

A brilliant allround performance from Zimbabwe has taken them over the line and they would be extremely pleased with their bowling performance. Their bowlers, yet again had decent enough runs on the board to defend and this time they started with a bang by making early inroads. Their new ball bowlers set the tone upfront and they grabbed 3 wickets inside the first 8 overs. Sri Lankans were put on the back foot straightaway and the spinners also did a good job of keeping things tight in the middle. Tendai Chatara and Blessing Muzarabani finished with 3 wickets to their name and Wesley Madhevere and Richard Ngarava took one wicket apiece. Overall, it was a fine bowling and fielding performance from Zimbabwe and they deserve to win this game.

What a comeback this has been from Zimbabwe! A comfortable victory for the tourists in the end and they are alive in this ODI series! Sri Lanka would be disappointed as they were in a position to chase this down when Kamindu Mendis and Dasun Shanaka were cruising along nicely but have fallen apart at the fag end.

Fuller, outside off. Dasun Shanaka steps down and pushes it towards long off for a single.
BEAUTY! A loopy ball, around middle and off. Dasun Shanaka presents the full face of the bat and looks to defend, but gets beaten as the ball turns away from him and beats him on the outside edge.
Loopy ball, around off. Dasun Shanaka leans and blocks it out.
Wellington Masakadza comes into the attack now.
Full, around off. Kamindu Mendis drives it to the fielder at extra cover.
On a length, around middle. Dasun Shanaka tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That's pure timing and placement! A full ball, wide of off. Dasun Shanaka leans, opens the face of his bat, and guides it towards deep backward point for a boundary.
Another full ball, around off. Dasun Shanaka blocks it out solidly.
Touch fuller, angling across off. Dasun Shanaka taps it to point.
Up and over! Full and outside off. Kamindu Mendis slashes this uppishly towards deep point but only for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Very full, width on offer. Dasun Shanaka slashes this over cover for a boundary. Good over for Sri Lnaka!
Outside off, fuller in length. Dasun Shanaka pushes it to point and takes off for a single. He is sent back by his partner and puts in a dive to get inside the crease.
Flatter, around middle. Dasun Shanaka looks to nudge this away but gets a leading edge towards cover. No run there.
SIX! BANG! That sounded so sweet as soon as it left the bat. A loopy ball, outside off. Dasun Shanaka gets low and slog-sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter, around middle. Kamindu Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Dasun Shanaka hangs back and pushes it to long on for a single.
Touch fuller, outside off. Kamindu Mendis pushes it towards mid off. Dot to the end the over.
Outside off, on a length, blocked out.

FOUR LEG BYES! Much needed runs for Sri Lanka. On a length, sprays it down the leg side. Kamindu Mendis goes for the flick but misses. The ball brushes off his pad and races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Zimbabwe pacers still getting some swing here. A length ball, outside off, shaping away late. Kamindu Mendis swings hard at it but misses it completely.
Edgy runs! A fuller ball, outside off. Dasun Shanaka prods to drive, but the ball takes off from the inside edge of the blade towards fine leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, around off. Dasun Shanaka defends it with the full face of his bat.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Kamindu Mendis keeps it out.
On a length, around middle. Dasun Shanaka eases it down to long on for a single.
BEATEN! Flatter ball, on a length, outside off and going on with the angle. Dasun Shanaka hangs back to block but the ball zips past his outside edge.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe on top! They have demolished Sri Lanka's top-order, and have dominated the innings till now. They are targeting the right areas and have been very disciplined with their lines and lengths. Sri Lanka are in deep trouble here and are in desperate need of a good partnership to rebuild their innings. Also, Dasun Shanaka comes to the crease now.

OUT! BOWLED! What a delivery to get rid of Asalanka! This ball had drift, turn and bounce as well! An off-spinner's delight, indeed! Madhevere serves a loopy ball, around middle which spins sharply after landing. Asalanka prods to defend but plays it inside the line of the ball and misses. The ball spins past his outside edge and cannons onto his off pole. Zimbabwe are all over Sri Lanka now.
Tossed up, around middle. Charith Asalanka keeps it out.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Kamindu Mendis punches it through the cover region and takes a run.
FOUR! Streaky but Sri Lanka will take that! Short of a length, outside off. Asalanka looks to cut and throws his bat at it. It takes the inside edge and goes past the keeper and into the fence.
Good-length ball, around middle. Charith Asalanka nudges it behind square on the leg side and comes back for the second run.
Short of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka blocks it to the off side. Another dot ball.
A bit fuller this time, around middle. Charith Asalanka turns it towards mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Kamindu Mendis cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Kamindu Mendis blocks it off the front foot.
Slightly shorter in length, around middle. Kamindu Mendis rocks back and whips it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Charith Asalanka eases it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Punished by Asalanka! Short ball, fired in around leg. Asalanka rocks back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Slight halt in play. The ball seems to be lost in the covers near the boundary. The groundsmen find the ball rapped in the covers. We are good to resume!
SIX! BANG! Asalanka brings out the slog sweep! This was looped up, on a length, around middle. Asalanka gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Flatter and quicker, coming in with the angle. Asalanka cuts it towards extra cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Kamindu Mendis drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
Good-length delivery, around off. Charith Asalanka stays back and taps it towards backward point.
On a length, outside off. Kamindu Mendis opens the face of his bat and steers it towards third man for a single.
Swing and a miss! Short of a length, well outside off. Kamindu Mendis looks to cut but he misses.
Ngarava goes fuller this time, around middle. Charith Asalanka flicks it wide of the mid on fielder for a run.
Short of a length, just outside off. Kamindu Mendis rocks back and punches it towards deep cover for one.
Wide! Too wide, outside off. Kamindu Mendis misses his cut shot and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Back of a length, outside off. Charith Asalanka stands tall and punches it towards deep cover for a single.
Richard Ngarava comes into the attack.
A bit quicker, on a length, around off. Kamindu Mendis stays back and punches it to the cover fielder.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Mendis blocks it to the off side.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Kamindu Mendis taps it towards backward point.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, outside off. Kamindu Mendis blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, around off. Charith Asalanka taps it to wide of the cover fielder for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Charith Asalanka drives it towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
Time for Powerplay 2, Zimbabwe will now be allowed to keep 4 fielders outside the circle till the 40th over. Also, Wesley Madhevere comes into the attack.
On a length, around off. Kamindu Mendis blocks it on the leg side. Sri Lanka are 34/3 at the end of Powerplay 1.
Darting it on the pads this time, on a length. Charith Asalanka flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Charith Asalanka gets on top of that bounce and blocks it out. The bat slips from the batter's hand and flies on the leg side.
Another length delivery, outside off. Charith Asalanka gets an outside edge towards point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Charith Asalanka, on the back foot, blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Charith Asalanka lets that go through to the keeper.
On a length, around off. Kamindu Mendis hops and blocks it out.

Up and over! A fuller ball, outside off. Kamindu Mendis slashes it over cover. Richard Ngarava from the third man region runs to his left, dives, and stops the ball from crossing the ropes. Two runs taken. Top effort in the deep!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Kamindu Mendis defends it out on the off side.
Fuller in length, outside off. Kamindu Mendis drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Outside off, shorter delivery. Kamindu Mendis, on the back foot, blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Kamindu Mendis taps it to point. Dot ball.
Back of a length, around middle. Charith Asalanka defends it back to the bowler. End of a successful over by Blessing Muzarabani!
Charith Asalanka walks out to bat at number 5.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Zimbabwe have taken another wicket here and Sri Lanka fall into deeper trouble. This is some brilliant bowling by Blessing Muzarabani. Touch fuller again, shaping away from outside off, and forcing the batter to drive again. Dinesh Chandimal presses forward and looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge towards first slip. Sikandar Raza there, gets low and pouches it comfortably. Sri Lanka are now 3 down and in all sorts of trouble!
Commentary.Howout: c Sikandar Raza b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller delivery, around the off pole. Dinesh Chandimal drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Blessing Muzarabani drops it short again, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal, on the back foot, punches it towards cover for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal hops and defends it out.
FOUR! Oh, shot! Stand and deliver! A fuller ball, on the pads. Kamindu Mendis stands, uses his wrists, and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Touch shorter, around middle. Kamindu Mendis pushes it back to the bowler.
Another length ball, outside off. Kamindu Mendis dabs it to backward point. No run there
A huge shout for LBW, but not given! On a length, nipping back in on the pads. Kamindu Mendis misses his flick and gets rapped on the front pad. That was probably sliding down leg.
On a length again, outside the off pole. Kamindu Mendis blocks it out solidly.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Kamindu Mendis taps it to point. Dot ball.
On a length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal leaves it alone.
Dinesh Chandimal is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Blessing Muzarabani strikes and sends back Pathum Nissanka. A wicket right after the drop! A fuller ball, shaping away from outside off, forcing the batsman to drive. Pathum Nissanka prods and goes for the drive but manages to get a thick outside edge back to the keeper. Regis Chakabva takes a good catch to dismiss Pathum Nissanka.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Another opportunity goes begging! A fuller ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka leans and drives it uppishly towards mid off. Craig Ervine there gets low and tries to grab it but fails to pouch. Pathum Nissanka gets a lifeline!
Length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! Lovely! Back of a length, around middle. Pathum Nissanka hangs back and pulls it past mid-wicket for a beautiful boundary.
A fuller ball, around off. Kamindu Mendis taps it to mid off and scampers through to the other end for a single.
On a length, around off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it off the front foot.
Full ball, around off. Kamindu Mendis pushes it wide of the cover fielder and collects a run.
Kamindu Mendis comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Tendai Chatara gets his man and he has been rewarded for his exceptional line and length with the new ball. This was a length ball, just outside off and nipping back in just that little bit off the deck. Mendis looks for a booming drive but he misses as the ball sneaks through his bat and pad and crashes onto the stumps. Sri Lanka lose their first wicket.
Back of a length, around off. Kusal Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Length ball, around off. Kusal Mendis blocks it out.

FOUR! Lucky escape for Mendis! Good-length ball, just outside off and shaping away a bit. Kusal Mendis looks to block but it takes the outside edge and flies past the keeper. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Nicely done! Banged into the deck, around off. Pathum Nissanka pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and bags a boundary.
Shorter in length, outside off. Pathum Nissanka looks to push it through the cover region but it goes off the inside half of the blade towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length, around off. Pathum Nissanka rides the bounce nicely and keeps it out.
Finds the gap this time! Slightly shorter in length, just outside off. Kusal Mendis hangs back, opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, just outside off. Kusal Mendis prods and taps it towards the backward point fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Kusal Mendis keeps it out watchfully.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length, outside off and shaping away late. Pathum Nissanka looks to drive on the up but he misses.
Good-length delivery, around off. Nissanka lunges forward to keep it out.
Chatara drags his length back a bit around off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it out.
Good-length ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka tucks it to mid-wicket.
Nicely played! Back of a length, just outside off. Pathum Nissanka stays back and punches it past the cover fielder to collect a couple of runs.
Length ball, outside off. Kusal Mendis looks to defend but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards third man for a run.
On a length, just outside off. Pathum Nissanka presses forward to block it out.
Short of a length, around off. Pathum Nissanka taps it towards backward point.
Fuller in length, outside off. Pathum Nissanka square drives it past the diving point fielder for a couple of runs.
On a length, outside off. Pathum Nissanka taps it towards backward point.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Back of a length, just outside off. Pathum Nissanka hangs back and punches it through the cover-point region for a boundary.

DROPPED! Huge moment in this game as Kusal Mendis could be dangerous here for Zimbabwe. Back of a length, well outside off. Kusal Mendis stays back and cuts hard. It goes off the thick outside edge towards the third man fielder. The fielder there moves to his left but makes a mess of it. The batters take a run.
Blessing Muzarabani will bowl from the other end.
Good-length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka is solid in his defense yet again. A maiden over from Chatara! Good start for Zimbabwe.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! This was a full ball, angling in from middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Pathum Nissanka defends it solidly.
Good-length delivery, around off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it out.
On a length, just outside off. Pathum Nissanka looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the underedge towards the keeper.
Chatara starts with a length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka defends it to the off side.
